title: 第3章 这游戏居然有独立cv第4章 全都给你炸完
slug: 氪金仙尊首先6元即赠绝色剑仙
content_zh:
李清然从来没见过这样的事。
对于修士来说盖个宅子很简单，但瞬间将一个破茅屋变成石砌宅子可不简单。
更别说凭空变出衣服、食物。
从有到有和从无到有可是两种概念。
起初她以为是有大修士在戏耍她，隐身后从储物戒里拿东西出来，却没有感觉到任何空间波动，所有的一切都是凭空出现的。
能做到从无到有，还能把食物的色香味全部做到位，再怎么也是个化神期的大修士吧？
或者……合体期？
李清然不清楚。
反正她的师父，化神期老妖怪，青玄道人做不到这一步。
他只能将食材转化成做好的美食，却不能让美食凭空出现。当然也不排除青玄道人从来没有研究过这种技法，毕竟筑基期就可以辟谷了。
食物的香味儿勾得李清然馋虫大动，修为被废后她已经无法辟谷，妖兽的肉很多都是剧毒，她无从分辨，只能吃山间的野果与草根。
就这么躲在床底下也不是办法。
李清然小心翼翼从床上探出半个脑袋，鼓起勇气喊道：“哪位前辈在此施法？晚辈李清然，斗胆请求前辈出来一见？”
四周静悄悄的，无人回应，只有暴雨敲打竹窗的声音。
李清然沉默了一会儿，决定还是先从床底下出来。
说不害怕那是假的，但想到对方神通广大，真要做什么她有反抗的余地吗？刚刚脚掌心还被点了一下，那位前辈的手倒是暖和，似乎在嘲笑她躲在床底下还漏了马脚……
一想到这，李清然咬了咬下唇，脸也红了。
算了，死就死吧。
她从床底下钻出来，环顾一圈儿，没有在房间里看到可疑的人影，
最终目光还是不争气地落在桌子上的大鱼大肉上。

“咕咚——！”
咽口水的声音和肚子里的轰鸣同时响起。
她扭捏地坐到桌前，盯着桌子上的菜，却没动筷子。
而是双手抱拳，叩首再拜道：“若前辈不愿出面，可否告知清然，这些食物清然能否食用？若前辈不说话，清然纵使饿死也不会动前辈的东西。”
话罢，李清然就坐在一桌美食面前，
两眼一闭，打坐入定。
陈怀安随便炒了个番茄炒蛋就对付了午餐。
回来打开手机一看，只见李清然已经从床下出来，正坐在饭桌前打坐，只是她的身体摇摇欲坠，花猫般的脸蛋上沾着些汗珠，鼻翼一扇一扇的，显然正强忍着食物的诱惑。
“这什么造型？”陈怀安乐了。
哪有对着食物打坐的？锻炼意志力吗？这小姑娘下巴都快悬在烤鸡上了。
【李清然请求食用营养餐，是否同意？】
一个对话框弹出来。
“这玩意儿还得我同意啊？那么严格？”
陈怀安哑然失笑地摇了摇头，选择同意。
画面中的李清然像是听到了什么，睁开眼，脸上露出欣喜的神情。
“谢前辈！”
“我丢，还有声音！”
冷不丁传出个清脆悦耳的女声吓得陈怀安差点儿没把手机扔了。主要刚刚没开声音，因为这游戏没有bgm，他就以为没声音。后来开了音量才发现有很真实的环境音，比如火炉燃烧的噼啪声，还有外面暴雨倾盆的声音。
但他从没想过李清然还有专门的cv。
果然还是那句话，小作坊用料猛！

陈怀安继续欣赏女孩吃饭。
content_en:
Li Qingran had never seen anything like this.
It is easy for a monk to build a house, but it is not easy to turn a dilapidated hut into a stone house in an instant.
Not to mention conjuring clothes and food out of thin air.
From something to something and from nothing to something are two different concepts.
At first she thought that a great monk was playing tricks on her. She took out things from the storage ring after turning invisible, but she didn't feel any spatial fluctuations. Everything appeared out of thin air.
He can make something from scratch, and he can also make the color, flavor, and flavor of the food perfect. After all, he is still a great monk in the stage of becoming a god, right?
Or... the integration period?
Li Qingran didn't know.
Anyway, her master, an old monster in the spirit transformation stage, Taoist Qingxuan couldn't do this.
He can only transform ingredients into delicious food, but he cannot make delicious food appear out of thin air. Of course, it does not rule out that Taoist Qingxuan has never studied this technique. After all, fasting can be achieved during the foundation building stage.
The smell of the food aroused Li Qingran's greed. After her cultivation was abolished, she could no longer live without food. Many of the meats of monster beasts were highly poisonous. She had no way of distinguishing them, so she could only eat wild fruits and grass roots in the mountains.
Just hiding under the bed is not an option.
Li Qingran carefully poked half of his head out of the bed and summoned up the courage to shout: "Which senior is casting a spell here? Junior Li Qingran, do you dare to ask the senior to come out and see me?"
There was silence all around, no one responded, only the sound of heavy rain beating on the bamboo windows.
Li Qingran was silent for a while and decided to get out from under the bed first.
She would be lying if she said she wasn't afraid, but when she thought about the other party's powerful powers, would she have any room to resist if he really wanted to do something? The sole of her foot was tapped just now, but the senior's hand was warm, as if he was laughing at her for missing the mark while hiding under the bed...
Thinking of this, Li Qingran bit her lower lip and blushed.
Forget it, just die.
She got out from under the bed and looked around, but saw no suspicious figure in the room.
In the end, his eyes fell on the big fish and meat on the table.
"Gudong——!"
The sound of swallowing and the roar in the stomach sounded at the same time.
She sat down at the table nervously, staring at the dishes on the table without moving her chopsticks.
Instead, he cupped his fists with both hands, kowtowed and bowed again: "If senior is unwilling to come forward, can you tell Qingran whether the food can be eaten by Qingran? If senior does not speak, Qingran will not touch senior's things even if he starves to death."
After saying that, Li Qingran sat in front of a table of delicious food.
Close your eyes and meditate.
Chen Huaian just fried some tomato scrambled eggs for lunch.
When I came back and turned on my phone, I saw that Li Qingran had come out from under the bed and was sitting at the dining table meditating. However, her body was shaky, her cat-like face was stained with sweat, and her nose was flaring. She was obviously resisting the temptation of food.
"What kind of look is this?" Chen Huai was happy.
How can anyone meditate in front of food? Exercise willpower? This little girl's chin is almost hanging on the roast chicken.
[Li Qingran requested a nutritious meal, do you agree? 】
A dialog box pops up.
"Does this thing require my consent? So strict?"
Chen Huaian shook his head with a dumb smile and chose to agree.
Li Qingran in the picture seemed to have heard something. He opened his eyes with a look of joy on his face.
"Thank you, senior!"
"I lost it, there is still a sound!"
Suddenly, a clear and sweet female voice came out, which scared Chen Huaian and almost threw his phone away. The main reason was that the sound was turned off just now, because there was no BGM in this game, so he thought there was no sound. Later, when I turned up the volume, I discovered that there were very real ambient sounds, such as the crackle of a burning stove and the sound of heavy rain pouring outside.
But he never thought that Li Qingran had a special CV.
Sure enough, the same sentence is true, the materials used in small workshops are strong!
Chen Huaian continued to admire the girl eating.
